mapper.insert: insert into product (name, description, price, stock, category_id, brand, main_image, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{categoryId}, #{brand}, #{mainImage}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select * from product where name like concat('%',#{productName},'%') and valid = '1'
select * from product where valid = '1' and id = #{id}
mapper.update: update product set valid = '0' where id = #{productId}
